invariants.text: Customer.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
AuditLog.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
AuditLog.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.id
Every customer creation operation must generate an audit log entry with the operation type 'create', the customer ID of the newly created customer, and the current timestamp.
Every customer update operation must generate an audit log entry with the operation type 'update', the customer ID of the customer being updated, and the current timestamp.
Every customer deletion operation must generate an audit log entry with the operation type 'delete', the customer ID of the customer being deleted, and the current timestamp.
The audit log must include the customer ID associated with the operation being performed.
The audit log must include the timestamp of when the operation was performed.
The audit log must include the operation type ('create', 'update', or 'delete') that describes the action taken on the customer.
